_comment: Team-shared Claude Code settings. Personal overrides go in settings.local.json (git-ignored). See docs/claude-guide.md.

permissions._comment_deny: Bash deny rules are prefix-matched and best-effort — the real secret boundary is container isolation + Claude reviewing every diff (there is deliberately NO gitleaks/detect-secrets scanner; see CLAUDE.md Constraints), not this list.

hooks.command: echo "export PYTHONPATH=$PWD" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; [ -f pyproject.toml ] && command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv sync --frozen -q 2>/dev/null || true

{ grep -q '<PLACEHOLDER' CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null || grep -q 'P00000' config/config.toml 2>/dev/null; } && echo 'This clone is still the UNCONFIGURED Morphum template (placeholders in CLAUDE.md and/or the template project code still in config). Unless the user is working on the template itself, offer to run the /new-project guided setup interview before other work.' || true

[ -f references/post-setup-TODO.md ] && echo 'Project setup is configured but NOT finalised: references/post-setup-TODO.md still lists template elements to prune or rewrite (unused machinery, README/CLAUDE.md). Offer to work through it; delete the file once done.' || true
[ -f references/project-brief.md ] && { echo '--- PROJECT MEMORY (references/project-brief.md — keep current via the remember skill) ---'; head -c 6000 references/project-brief.md; } || true
